mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because it linked breathing and blood flow to oxygen delivery at tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add the lining to the open lung spaces was confusing: the pieces seemed suited to each other, but the spaces had no available combination at that point.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the lining first combined with the capillary mesh rather than directly with the air sacs; the resulting gas arrows clarified the separate air and blood spaces.

arbitrary.text: The required order for combining the lining felt somewhat arbitrary until the compatibility information showed the capillary mesh as its partner.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the oxygen-delivering circulation supports the working arm. The connections between chest movement, gas exchange and circulation held my interest.
